questions.question: What specific problems does Tovy solve?
questions.answer: Tovy automates manual processes. For example, we build automated connections that sync order data from Shopify to Exact Online flawlessly. This eliminates hours of work and costly entry errors.

questions.question: How does Tovy differ from a traditional IT partner?
questions.answer: We don't deliver advisory reports; we deliver working code. Our engineering mindset focuses on reliable, maintainable solutions using standard technology (Python/Azure). You work directly with your engineer, without the overhead of account managers.

questions.question: What type of company is Tovy best suited for?
questions.answer: Our expertise is most valuable for e-commerce and retail companies that depend on flawless synchronization between logistics, finance, and sales. If you struggle with inventory discrepancies or slow reporting, Tovy can make an immediate impact.

questions.question: Why choose Tovy over a large consulting firm?
questions.answer: Tovy offers the expertise of a senior data engineer without the large-firm overhead. We focus on tangible results in 6-week sprints. Instead of endless meetings, we deliver a working, automated workflow.

questions.question: What do I get for the project starting price?
questions.answer: A fixed-budget project delivers a concrete, automated result in 6 weeks. This includes setting up your Azure data infrastructure, syncing your daily sales data, and creating a Power BI dashboard for live margin insights.

questions.question: How can I book a consultation?
questions.answer: Start by filling out our project intake form. It maps out your needs so our first conversation is immediately in-depth.

questions.question: What is the average implementation time?
questions.answer: A foundational data system is typically running within 6 weeks. This covers everything from strategic design to launching your core data infrastructure and automation pipelines.

questions.question: Where can I find technical case studies?
questions.answer: Our methodologies are documented in the Knowledge Hub. This archive contains technical articles, best practices, and practical implementations.

privacy.title: Privacy Statement
privacy.intro: Privacy is important to Tovy. We respect your privacy regarding information collected via this website, in full compliance with GDPR.

sections.title: Processing controller
sections.content: Tovy is the controller for personal data collected through this website. For questions, contact us via:

sections.title: Data collection and use
sections.content: We only ask for data necessary to provide our services. We collect it lawfully with your explicit consent, based on contractual necessity or legitimate interest.
list: Project request form: We collect contact and project details. This is stored in Google Cloud Firestore to assess your request.
Server logs: Firebase Hosting records requests (IP, browser, pages visited) to maintain security.
Cookies: We use necessary cookies to manage consent preferences. We do not use tracking cookies without your explicit prior consent.

sections.title: Data location and transfer
sections.content: To protect your data, our primary database (Cloud Firestore) is hosted within the EU (region 'eur3'). Any international transfers by subcontractors are done via legally permitted mechanisms, such as standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.content: We retain data only as long as necessary for our services or as required by law. We secure your data with current industry measures to prevent loss, theft, or unauthorized access.

sections.title: Rights under the GDPR
sections.content: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your data:
list: Right to information: Know how your data is collected/used
Right of access: Request a copy of your information
Right to portability: Receive data in a machine-readable format
Right to object: Object to the processing of your data
sections.footer: To exercise these rights, contact us via the e-mail address below.

privacy.effectiveDate: This policy has been in effect since July 30, 2024.
privacy.metaDescription: Tovy respects your privacy. Read our GDPR-compliant policy regarding data collection, processing, and server-side tracking.
